captions_note: the reel's captions stay on. A 'chest' tag can sit where the reel's caption band is: look at one snapshot inside the slot, and if they touch, use anchor 'cap' or 'head' or hide the reel captions for the slot (--hide-captions a-b)
in_a_reel: keep GRADE = 'none' (the reel owns the look)
the tag comes on at IN_F at the earliest and leaves 9 frames before the slot ends, so both edges are the plain picture. Give it at least 1.5 s on screen
the tag text is the buyer's own word or two for the thing they are talking about: no number or claim they do not say
steps: run track.py      # measure the speaker's head, chest and the word starts (about 30 s); read what it prints
edit the CLIP block in build.py, then build with the guide on; fix every line that starts with !!
hf snapshot --at 1.0,2.2,3.8      # snapshot at landing + 0.3 s, the middle, and 0.5 s before the end (times in seconds)
run build.py      # build without the guide, then render
run check.py      # numbers, sheet, lock crops, stills, phone copy
